name: toast
title: Toast
description: Notifications with an imperative toast() and one Toaster to mount: announced to screen readers, paused on hover and focus, kept while an error or a choice is shown.
docs: Mount <Toaster /> once, near the root of your app, then call toast({ title: "Saved" }) from anywhere. The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.
